latest.title: What Students Need to Know About Building with AWS
latest.description: Before you open the AWS console, there are things nobody tells you. This article covers what students genuinely need to know — how to use the Free Tier without getting a surprise bill, which services to learn first, five realistic projects you can build today, why IAM security is non-negotiable, and how to think in cloud architecture. A practical, honest guide to building with AWS confidently.

latest.title: Service Mesh Intercontas com Zero Trust: Roteamento de Camada 7 via Amazon VPC Lattice
latest.description: Uma análise arquitetônica profunda sobre a resolução da complexidade de redes leste-oeste em ecossistemas de microsserviços distribuídos. O artigo disseca a implementação do Amazon VPC Lattice para abstrair blocos CIDR sobrepostos e emparelhamentos de VPC (VPC Peering). Através da construção de redes de serviço gerenciadas, roteamento baseado em cabeçalhos (L7) e autenticação criptográfica rigorosa utilizando AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4), a arquitetura consolida uma postura de segurança Zero Trust.

latest.title: Senhas fortes — a base de tudo

latest.title: PadippuAI — Building Tamil Nadu's First Open Engineering-Admissions MCP Server with Amazon Nova Pro
latest.description: Most Tamil Nadu students miss 80% of scholarships they qualify for and choose engineering colleges blind to placement data. This post walks through building a bilingual English + Tamil AI agent on Amazon Nova Pro that unifies TNEA cutoffs, scholarships, NIRF ranks, fees and career pathways behind a custom MCP server — reusable by Claude Desktop and any future agent.

latest.title: Karpenter em Produção: Guia Prático para Escalar seu Cluster Kubernetes
latest.description:
O Karpenter observa pods Pending e provisiona o nó ideal em segundos — sem ASGs, sem node groups fixos. Ele escolhe tipo de instância, AZ e Spot/On-Demand automaticamente. Em produção, a diferença é clara: consolidação automática remove nós ociosos, diversificação de instâncias reduz interrupções Spot, e você para de pagar por capacidade parada. Neste artigo cubro instalação, NodePool, EC2NodeClass, tags e armadilhas comuns. 

#Kubernetes #AWS #EKS #Karpenter #DevOps

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
